items.title: ToothPaste sends secure HID input
items.oneliner: Encrypted USB HID bridge lets you type passwords into air-gapped devices from a browser without installing software.

items.title: Postgres queue scaling benchmark
items.oneliner: Hands-on benchmark shows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED queues hitting 650 jobs per second with 20 pooled connections.

items.title: Spindle brings type-safe OCaml web apps
items.oneliner: OCaml 5 web framework ships RFC-strict HTTP, Eio multicore support, OpenAPI docs, and type-safe JSON end to end.

items.title: Coldframe emulates fridge controllers
items.oneliner: Single-file Python honeypot mimics supermarket fridge controllers and logs passwords, exploits, and attacker behavior with no dependencies.

items.title: Libghostty stabilizes terminal embedding
items.oneliner: Production-ready C terminal emulation library now guarantees ABI stability for embedding terminals in editors, IDEs, and custom apps.

items.title: ZeBridge syncs Postgres over NATS
items.oneliner: Zig-based tool replicates PostgreSQL to edge devices over NATS with quickstarts, telemetry, auth, and Docker deployment.

items.title: Go tests with MustCreate
items.oneliner: Practical Go 1.18 pattern uses generics to remove repetitive test setup and error handling from helper functions.

items.title: DTLS 1.3 in Pion
items.oneliner: Deep implementation writeup covers 400 commits of DTLS 1.3 work in Pion, including one-RTT handshakes and PQ key exchange.

items.title: Text.js renders React in logs
items.oneliner: Full-stack React framework renders interactive UIs inside console.log with Suspense, keyboard input, tables, and charts.

items.title: PostgreSQL internals reference PDF
